description: Defines the interface ISystemAudioPlayer for system audio playback control, including methods for configuration, playback control, and notifications within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: ISystemAudioPlayer
classes.description: Interface for controlling system audio playback, including methods for opening, playing, pausing, stopping, and configuring the audio player, as well as registering notifications.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for receiving SAP event notifications from the audio player.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the SAP plugin with the provided service interface.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for SAP events.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens an audio player instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback of audio with given parameters.

methods.name: PlayBuffer
methods.description: Starts playback of Base64 encoded audio buffer.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets the mixer levels for the audio.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Checks if the audio player is currently playing.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the audio player.

methods.name: GetPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID of the audio player.
